Budget.description: A stage budget the class allows, per stage and per Warrant.

budget_tokens.description: Ceiling on each stage's `budget_tokens`; at most [`MAX_BUDGET_TOKENS`].

max_deliverables.description: Most deliverables one covered Warrant may declare.

max_stages.description: Most stages one covered Warrant may declare.

wall_time_seconds.description:
Ceiling on each stage's `wall_time_seconds`; at most
[`MAX_WALL_TIME_SECONDS`].

description:
`oh.war/standing-authorization/v1`: the class a human signs.

Every field is required and no other field is accepted.

assurance.description: `basic`, the only assurance level a class may cover.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC; at most [`MAX_EXPIRY_SECONDS`] after the signature.

gates.description: Gates a covered obligation may cite; includes [`REQUIRED_GATES`].

id.description: `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*`, the name the class is referred to by.

max_warrants.description: At most this many Warrants are covered; at most [`MAX_WARRANTS`].

meaning.description: The owner's own words for what the signature grants.

paths.description: Globs a covered Warrant may declare as deliverables.

profile.description: `delivery`, the only profile a class may cover.

revision.description: 1, 2, …: a wider or narrower class is a new revision, signed again.

title: StandingAuthorization
